```{r,echo=FALSE}
# y = (x-a)/b
# by+a = x

yab = sample(2:9,3)
y = yab[1]*sample(c(-1,1),1)
a = yab[2]
b = yab[3]

x = b*y+a


```


Question
========

Let function $f$ be defined by the algebraic expression below:

$$f(x)=\frac{x-`r a`}{`r b`}$$

Evaluate $f(`r x`)$.


Solution
========


$$f(`r x`)=\frac{`r x`-`r a`}{`r b`}$$


$$f(`r x`)=\frac{`r x-a`}{`r b`}$$

$$f(`r x`)=`r y`$$
